notes:
TCC Website 0.14.7: "Learn more" opens the Cookie Policy page

- "Learn more" on the cookie banner now goes to the website's own Cookie
  Policy page (/cookie-policy/) instead of Termly's small window. Termly has
  no setting for this, so a short script (features/termly-look.js) catches
  the click, or Enter or Space, just before Termly does. Ctrl/Cmd-click
  opens a new tab. Screen readers hear it as a link.
- If that page is not published, nothing is added and "Learn more" opens
  Termly's window as before. Not added in the Divi editor.
- Help tab, AI prompts, notes and rollback steps updated. New test file;
  251 tests pass on PHP 8.3 and 7.4.
